defs.def: to make sure that sth happens or is definite 保证；担保；确保

ex.s: This adaptability ensures that complex historical concepts become accessible and engaging for young minds.
ex.t: 这种适应性确保复杂的历史概念能够被年轻的心灵所理解和喜爱。

ex.s: This mountain walk provides an insight into the skills required for hillwalking to ensure you get the most from future walking trips.
ex.t: 这次山地徒步让你了解山地徒步所需的技能，确保你在今后的徒步旅行中收获最大。

ex.s: If you take an online course, what can you do to ensure the best possible grade?
ex.t: 如果你参加在线课程，你能做些什么来确保取得尽可能好的成绩？

ex.s: Artificial intelligence ensures humans a bright future.
ex.t: 人工智能确保人类光明的未来。

ex.s: To ensure the supply of energy.
ex.t: 确保能源供应。

ex.s: To ensure harmony in care homes.
ex.t: 确保养老院的和谐。

ex.s: Knowing some tips will help ensure that you have an enjoyable meal with friends or family — no matter where you are in the world.
ex.t: 了解一些小贴士有助于确保你无论在世界何处都能与朋友或家人享受愉快的用餐。

ex.s: This was the very door I ____2____ guided the children through to ensure their safety from the bitter cold.
ex.t: 这正是那扇我____2____引导孩子们穿过以确保他们免受严寒侵袭的门。

ex.s: This has been adopted to ensure easier detection of gas leaks.
ex.t: 这已被采用以确保更容易检测燃气泄漏。

ex.s: Hunters willingly pay the stamp price to ensure the survival of our natural resources.
ex.t: 猎人乐意支付鸭票的价格，以确保我们的自然资源得以存续。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票收入中约有98美分直接进入候鸟保护基金，用于购买湿地和野生动物栖息地并纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，供子孙后代使用。

ex.s: To ensure their survival.
ex.t: 为了确保它们的生存。

ex.s: Passion alone does not ensure a person's success.
ex.t: 仅凭热情不能保证一个人的成功。

ex.s: While Queensland Rail makes every effort to ensure trains run as scheduled，there can be no guarantee of connections between trains or between train services and bus services.
ex.t: 虽然昆士兰铁路尽一切努力确保列车按计划运行，但无法保证列车之间或列车与巴士服务之间的衔接。

ex.s: Please ensure that you bring your existing card with you.
ex.t: 请确保你带上现有的卡。

ex.s: Although the   22   asks the members only to drive students to and from their classes, Wilson often goes   23   to ensure the welfare and safety of the students.
ex.t: 尽管__22__只要求成员接送学生上下课，威尔逊常常__23__以确保学生的福利和安全。

ex.s: GDA ensures that volunteers work with community members and local project partners where our help is needed.
ex.t: GDA确保志愿者在我们所需帮助的地方与社区成员和当地项目伙伴一起工作。

ex.s: A smoke detector is on the ceiling in your room． Some buildings also have heat detectors on the ceilings． Do the following to ensure the safe operation of your smoke detector：
ex.t: （按照以下做法以确保你的烟雾探测器安全运行：）

ex.s: （5）To ensure the safe operation of the smoke detector， one should     ．
ex.t: （5）为确保烟雾探测器安全运行，一个人应该____。

ex.s: Others say it’s only natural that newcomers learn the language of their host nation, seeing it as a condition to ensure they can contribute to society.
ex.t: 另一些人说，新来者学习所在国的语言是再自然不过的事，他们把这看作是为了确保自己能为社会做贡献的一个条件。

ex.s: Worried about her, Joy and Sadness try to work together to ensure she gets her core memories back.
ex.t: 出于对她的担心，快乐和悲伤努力合作，确保她能找回自己的核心记忆。

ex.s: He might have failed in his goal to cross Antarctica, but he had ensured that everyone on board the Endurance survived.
ex.t: 他或许未能实现穿越南极洲的目标，但他确保了“坚忍号”上所有人都活了下来。

ex.s: In this way, we could learn to exist in harmony with these wild animals and ensure our continued co-existence on the planet that we all share.
ex.t: 通过这种方式，我们可以学会与这些野生动物和谐共存，并确保我们在这个我们共同拥有的星球上继续共存下去。

ex.s: This new generation of artisans will not only help preserve traditional skills; the innovation they bring to the craft will also ensure that the art of clock repairing stands the test of time.
ex.t: 新一代工匠不仅将有助于保护传统技艺；他们给手艺带来的创新也将确保钟表修复艺术经得起时间的考验。

ex.s: For example, a single storm could destroy a whole year’s work, while a summer of good weather could ensure a good harvest.
ex.t: 例如，一场暴风雨就可能毁掉一整年的劳作，而一个夏季的好天气则可能确保丰收。
